skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general overview of hotel service operations.
Understand the operations of the front desk in hotels.
Understand the operations of housekeeping in hotels.
Understand the operations of food and beverage services in hotels.
Develop a service mindset for hotel operations.
Understand the importance of a service-oriented approach in hotel management.
Understand the management of hotel services including organizational structure, human resource management, and quality control processes.
Analyze guest needs during their stay at the hotel.
Understand the organization of labor in hotel departments.
Understand the standards required for employees in hotel departments.
Manage the service processes in hotel departments.
Control the quality of services provided in hotel departments.
Prepare for providing services to guests.
Handle the reception of guests during their stay.
Handle guest complaints effectively.
Understand and perform end-of-day procedures in hotel departments.
Understand the need for adaptability and continuous learning in hotel service management.
Understand health and safety standards in hotel service management.
Understand professional ethics in hotel service management.
Understand environmental responsibility in hotel service management.
Understand cultural values and traditions in hotel service management.
